subject: Gestational Protein Deprivation Primes Sexually Divergent Behavioral Aging Trajectories in Mice
script: From Agewell Brief: Gestational Protein Deprivation Primes Sexually Divergent Behavioral Aging Trajectories in Mice. Maternal nutrient restriction forces distinct metabolic and affective outcomes across the lifespan, driving early anxiety in males and late-life memory preservation at a hedonic cost in females. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
